title: Unique Length-3 Palindromic Subsequences
description: Given a lowercase string `s`, return the number of unique palindromes of length 3 that are subsequences of `s`. Even if the same 3-character palindrome can be formed in multiple index combinations, count it only once.
constraints: s consists of only lowercase English letters.
hints: A length-3 palindrome has the form X Y X, where X appears at least twice and Y appears strictly between two occurrences of X.
For each of the 26 letters X, find its first and last occurrence in s and count how many distinct characters appear strictly between them.

examples.explanation: The unique length-3 palindromic subsequences of "aabca" are "aba", "aaa", and "aca".
No character repeats in "adc", so there are 0 length-3 palindromes.
The unique palindromes in "bbcbaba" are "bbb", "bcb", "bab", and "aba".
